title: a native declaration without a provider fails without fallback
purpose: Calling an unlinked native never runs an Okkama body.

failure.justification: The grammar makes a missing provider a runtime error; no logical category beyond resolution/runtime is fixed.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: grammar: native calls resolve a mandatory provider by owner module, ABI major, name and arity; missing providers are runtime errors and never fall back to an Okkama body.
